apps.name: Oma Year Planner
apps.description: Your whole year on one screen. A local-first year calendar for Omarchy, with no backend, no account and no build step.

shots.alt: Oma Year Planner showing the sample year: Ski week, City break, Wedding weekend, Workshop, Coast week, Lake week, Autumn hike, and Year-end break.
A closer crop of the sample calendar from May onward, with Workshop, Coast week, Lake week, and Autumn hike.
The add-plan dialog on May 12 in the sample calendar. The name field is empty.
The sample calendar filtered to workshop, with the three Workshop plans still on the board.
A translucent Oma Year Planner window over a desktop wallpaper, showing the same sample plans.

apps.name: Kar Page launcher for Omarchy
apps.description: Launcher for Kar Page on Omarchy. It opens the live site in a Chromium app window.
apps.install: git clone https://github.com/KarPage/karpage-omarchy.git && cd karpage-omarchy && less install && ./install
apps.shotAlt: Placeholder for the Kar Page launcher. It opens karpage.app in a Chromium window.

apps.name: OmaAgentWatch
apps.description: Watch your Cursor cloud agents work live on your Omarchy desktop.
notes: Each working agent gets a big square card with a spinning orb, and idle ones collapse into slim rows so everything fits on one screen.

shots.alt: OmaAgentWatch demo on a wide desktop. Five working agents are square cards with spinning orbs, and idle agents are slim rows. The labels are samples: demo-api, oma-watch, OmaKarDash, worker, dotfiles, and Year planner.

rail.alt: OmaAgentWatch demo in a narrow window. Working agents stay square cards with spinning orbs, and the sample spend reads 24.40 of 40 dollars.

apps.name: OmaKarDash
apps.description: V1 is a Tesla dashboard for Omarchy showing charge and range, climate, tires, lock state, and software updates.
notes: It uses each owner's own Tesla developer app, reads Tesla's cached data without waking the car, and asks for a confirm on every command. No unlock, no location, and no remote start.

shots.alt: OmaKarDash Jade theme, a demo dashboard for the fictional car Northwind. The car is asleep and unplugged, at 78 percent charge and 251 miles, with the rear-right tire at 26 psi. The footer says unofficial and not affiliated with Tesla.
